blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A 50-year-old man was shot dead by motorcycle-riding assailants in Sitio Bontong, Barangay Camaman-an here on Friday, Sept. 25, police said. The victim, identified as Marlou Valmoria, a resident of the city’s Barangay Bonbon, was attacked at 11:15 a.m. and sustained a gunshot wound to the head, which killed him instantly. According to the official statement of the Cagayan de Oro City Police Office (COCPO), Valmoria had just returned from an errand and was alighting from a vehicle to open a gate when an unidentified individual approached and opened fire.
